newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 14.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 18.54 points at 7,274.21 as investors took profits amid uncertainty about whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates again next week.

* The European Union will next week ask fellow members of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) to agree to set up a panel to look into Indonesia's controversial national car policy, trade diplomats said on Tuesday.

Meanwhile, Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Economics and Finance Saleh Affif said the government regarded a previous proposal asking for a $1.3 billion loan to finance the national car programme as too high and said that the goverment would cut the proposed amount.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 2.95 points to close at 672.87 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,432.50/33.50 at 0120 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.00/31.50.
* Tourism firm Bayu Buana after it was suspended for about one hour on Tuesday following a 25 percent rise on Monday.
* Indosat as the state-controlled telecommunications firm was scheduled to release its first quarter results later on Wednesday.
* Summarecon on reports that the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) had asked the property firm for clarification over the firm's 1996 annual report.
* Supermarket chain Hero on market talk that retailer Matahari was likely to acquire Hero.
* Polyester manufacturer Polysindo on reports of a $800 million expansion programme.
* Energy firm Medco on reports that the firm's venture with Indonesian conglomerate Setdco had secured approval to buy a large stake in an oil firm in the central Asian nation of Kazakhstan.
